title: We Are Commanded to Ask the Expert
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) La ilaaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha illa-Llah
Sayyidina wa nabiyinna Muhammad `abduhu wa rasooluh. Zidhu yaa Rabbee, zidhu `izzan wa sharafan wa
nooran wa surooran Habeeb. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)

As-salaamu `alaykum `ibaadAllah, servants of Allah Almighty. Thumma salamu `alayka yaa Sayyidina Qutb
al-`Arifeen, Qutb al-Mutassarif who is looking after everything related to Creation on Earth. He is
responsible; one is enough for being responsible for every creature living on this planet. He is responsible
and his power may reach everything in existence on this planet through dunya. That is a heavenly order,
nizhaam.
As-salaamu `alaykum attenders from Mankind, attending and asking to hear and learn, and understand and
be more closer from heavenly stations. And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. O
our Lord! We are humbly asking on behalf of the Lord of Heavens that he who is responsible on this planet to
make us for understanding something. And as the Seal of Prophets (s) is advising to all nations, what is he
advising? His advising is so perfect, advising how to save people from darkness, from badness, from evil and

from devils, showing us the way. And we are asking humbly, because we don't know. Allah Almighty is saying:
••••••••• ••• •• •••••••
fas'al bihi khabeera
Ask the expert (who knows). (25:59)
O Salafi `ulamas! What you are understanding when Allah Almighty says, fas'al bihi khabeera? Yes? Allah,
Allah. That is an ocean; therefore, they are making me to address Salafi `ulamas because they are so proud,
saying, "We are Salafi `ulamas!" What does it mean, fas'al bihi khabeera? Allah, Allah. That is a heavenly
command/order and also heavenly ta`leemaat, instructions. Everyone must ask that fas'al bihi khabeera,
three words may change the face of this planet and may change the minds of all people living on this planet!
That is a heavenly addressing, a declaration, an order for mukallaf, who is responsible to their Lord, Almighty
Allah. What He means to say to His most glorified servant, most honored one in His Divinely Presence,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s), Allah Almighty is first addressing to him, and then addressing through that most
glorified and most honored and most beloved one's understanding. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)

First responsible is mukallaf, and so as Allah Almighty addresses to His most beloved one, His most glorified
one, the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Rasoolullah (s) is laa tukallafu illa nafsah (no one bears anyone's burden
except his own). Mukallaf, that responsibility is only for the Seal of Prophets (s). His most majestic one, most
glorified one, "You must ask Me," and all prophets must ask anything for learning, understanding, looking
and seeing, hearing and obeying through that one. "You are My representative, O My most beloved one! They
can't ask Me directly, that is impossible; they will be burned! Prophets can't address to Me directly, but they
may ask through you." Prophets are asking to the Seal of Prophets (s) and he is that one giving what they are
asking, fas'al bihi khabeera. So many things everyone may ask, and all prophets are also asking, but there is
no way for any prophet to ask directly from the Divinely Presence of the Lord of Divinity, Uloohiyyah (Allah's
Oneness). First prophets are responsible to ask, so they are in need of an honored one that has a connection
with divinely levels, and divinely levels are over heavenly levels. No one can pass from heavenly levels up,

even Archangel Gabriel (a) when the Seal of Prophets (s) said, "Come with me," he said, "I can't! It is only for
you, yaa Habeebullah!"
Where are the Wahabi people? In spite of their foolishness, too often they observe if a person is coming to a
holy tomb and raising their hands in du`a, Wahabi people are saying, "shirk, shirk!" They are no-mind
people. Allah Almighty is welcoming the Seal of Prophets (s) and only him, that no one can pass through not
even the thickness of a hair. Archangel Gabriel (a) said, "If I am passing a little bit more than a hair, the
divinely lights for Laahoot, the Station of Divinity, will burn me and I will never come back as I am now. This
passage is granted to you only! No one else is passing from this level, only you!" Allahu akbar!

And the holy order, fas'al bihi khabeera, is Allah Almighty's divinely order to all saints, prophets, and
messengers, all of them. This taaleem, instruction, is to teach all prophets that they can't ask anything
directly, they must ask that one who is khabeera, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) No
one else can be khabeera! You must learn this, Salafi `ulamas! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) Don't say, “We are
following that imaam, that imaam, that imaam.” No, they are knowing nothing. Allah Almighty is first
addressing to anbiyaa, prophets, "If you are not understanding something, you must ask that one who is My
representative from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. He is representing Me and no one can (approach Me), only I
am authorizing that one."

So from the time of Adam (a), Allah Almighty began (this protocol) that no one can address their Lord
directly without a waseelah, mediator. Yes, Adam (a) could speak through the Seal of Prophets (s). Also
Abraham (a) can't address for understanding something; he must ask through the Seal of Prophets (s), who is
khabeer, expert! He knows everything about Creation, no one else (has that knowledge). Nuh (a) can't be able
to reach the Divinely Presence of the Lord of Divinely Levels, and he was asking from the Seal of Prophets,
Sayyidina Rasoolullah (s). Moses (s) can't ask; if not going to be on Mt. Sinai one reality of the Seal of
Prophets (s); his reality is like endless oceans. Therefore, they are making me to say that with one of his
heavenly powers Sayyidina Musa (a) was speaking, else he was never able to come in the presence of the Lord
of Heavens (swt). He was in need of someone between him and his Lord, a waseelah, mediator. That is an

endless ocean; that is the meaning of fas'al bihi khabeera!

O Mankind! You must ask about that heavenly order because you are knowing nothing! Yes, you may say,
"We are knowing so many things through teknologia." It may be, but beyond teknologia, what it is? Who is
giving authority for teknologia to be under your command, tassarruf, who is that one? Now Mankind is
thinking, "We are reaching everything through our mentalities!" Your mentalities may be helping you as an
inner attribute for your deeply being as a creature. You are in need to be in touch with your Creator! And no
one can be able to reach that point to ask from their Creator, as Allah Almighty made this protocol for all
angels and prophets. Through His Divinity, the Lord of Heavens is referring to His Most Beloved
Representative, fas'al bihi khabeera. He is teaching where to go to ask the Seal of Prophets (s), who knows
that questioner's needs, and then Sayyidina Rasoolullah (s) will ask for that in Divinely Presence. Allah
Almighty made the Seal of Prophets (s) his Lord's mutlaq, Absolute Representative, and all prophets are
asking to learn something from his Spirituality Oceans.

And that is in Holy Qur'an, the Lord of Heavens saying, mukhaatiban, addressing to the Seal of Prophets (s),
so if he wasn't in existence no one is going to be in existence! And the Lord of Heavens is ordering to all
nations, "If you are not understanding, you must ask khabeer, the expert who knows what you need. If I am
giving to him, he is knowing the oceans that no one knows their muntahaa, end or depth. All prophets are
asking for understanding from the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidi 'r-Rusoolu 'l-Kiraam (master of the blessed
prophets), Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) We must also ask, because we have
been created to know something. When the Last Day arrives, angels will question common people, prophets
will question their nations, then all prophets will be questioned by the Seal of Prophets (s), who will be
questioned by his Lord, Almighty Allah. This is to show people that he is responsible!
You must have someone who knows more than you; you must ask and learn (from that one)! Allah Almighty
is ordering the nation of the Seal of Prophets (s), "If you are knowing or understanding, you must ask (...)
who knows about that one. Therefore I am asking to Salafi `ulamas, who is that one you are asking? Because

they may say, "We are asking from our `ulamas." From whom `ulamas are asking? Their knowledge is
reaching to the Seal of Prophets (s), so that you must ask. You must try to find someone who will carry you to
the holy presence of the Seal of Prophets (s), and then ask. On the Day of Resurrection, Judgment Day, don't
think that Allah Almighty is making judgment for everyone, no. But there are so many representatives on
behalf of the Lord of Heavens who will be questioning their nations.
Angels in the graveyard are asking, "Who is your Lord? Man Rabbuk?!"
You may say, "Yaa Rabbee, my Lord is Allah Almighty."
Angels saying, "From whom you learned this?"
"We learned from the Seal of Prophets (s), the most glorified one!"
Yes okay. It means between you and that one, he is going to be asked.
"That one, this one.... Do you think they were khabeer, experts for everything? We are looking for the teacher
who taught to you to say who is your Lord.'"
"My Lord is Allah Almighty.”
"And from whom you learned this answer? Can't be anyone without asking to learn something. Who is that
one?"

Therefore I am asking now, Salafi `ulamas, from whom are you learning your knowledge? On which base you
are building your knowledge? On a rock, on a tree, on a throne, on Earth, heavens; where you learned? Who
is that one referred to in Holy Qur'an, saying, fas'al bihi khabeera? If you are asking to learn something you
must ask someone that is authorized to answer what you are asking. Unauthorized peoples' answer has no
value, so go away!

Therefore, very, very, very few people are asking about their real being and doors of knowledge into neverending oceans. Give daily even five minutes for understanding. Also, you can't understand if there is not
someone making you to understand. Therefore, all prophets are giving to people understanding and their real
identity as believers or unbelievers. And it is an endless ocean (of knowledge)!

O People! Come and listen, not to be regretting one day. That is free teaching and this is heavenly teaching; it
is not from my knowledge that I learned, no. That is something obligatory for everyone to ask such a question
and to learn what does it mean. If you are not doing, you are going to be taken from humanity and sent to the
level of non-understanding creatures, as you like.
May Allah forgives us.

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah SubhaanAllah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah

Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy,
Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy,
Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy,
Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyyy, Hayyy,
Huuuuuuuuuu.

Fatihah.
Astaghfirullah.

(45 minutes) Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, yaa Rabbee, shukr! Shukr, yaa Rabbee!
(Mawlana makes sajdatu 'sh-shukr in thanks to Allah Almighty.)
